<p>Describe an app, a game, a website, or a dashboard in <a href="https://grok.com/?referrer=website&amp;mode=build">Grok</a>, and Grok builds a working version live in your chat — on the web, on iOS, and on Android.</p>
<p>When we <a href="/news/grok-build-mode">introduced it in July</a>, building in Grok was an Early Beta limited to SuperGrok Heavy. Since then we&#x27;ve made it faster, taught it to publish and share what you make, wired it into X, and given the apps it builds access to our own models. All of that ships to everyone today.</p>
<div class="not-prose my-12 space-y-5"><h3 class="font-display text-2xl tracking-tight">Made with Grok Build</h3><p class="text-primary max-w-xl leading-[1.75]">Every example below is a real published <h2 id="publish-to-a-link-share-it-anywhere"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#publish-to-a-link-share-it-anywhere">Publish to a link, share it anywhere</a></h2>
<p>Every app you publish gets its own address on <code>grok.me</code>, and you decide who can open it: just you, anyone with the link, or the whole internet. Bring your own domain if you&#x27;d rather.</p>
<p>Grok also creates the art that travels with the link. Each app gets a cover that unfurls as a rich preview wherever it&#x27;s pasted — messages, chats, docs, the timeline. It&#x27;s generated for your specific app, and you can regenerate it, upload your own, or ask Grok to redesign it mid-conversation.</p>

<h2 id="made-for-the-timeline"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#made-for-the-timeline">Made for the timeline</a></h2>
<p>Apps you share on X don&#x27;t arrive as bare links. The banner renders inline, carries your handle, and games get a play affordance in the card, so people meet the app before they ever leave the feed.</p>
<h2 id="build-powerful-apps"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#build-powerful-apps">Build powerful apps</a></h2>
<p>Turn on the SpaceXAI APIs for an app and it can call Grok for chat, images, and voice from inside its own code — no keys to create, paste, or rotate. A trivia game can write new questions on demand, a support page can answer in your voice, a notes app can summarize itself. Access is per app, and you can revoke it at any time.</p>
<p>Also new since the Early Beta:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Remix.</strong> Let others fork a published app and make it their own.</li>
<li><strong>Custom domains.</strong> Point a domain you own at your app.</li>
<li><strong>Export to GitHub.</strong> Push the whole project to a repo and keep going in an editor, or in <a href="/news/grok-build-cli">Grok Build for the terminal</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Secrets.</strong> Store API keys for third-party services outside your app&#x27;s code.</li>
<li><strong>Connectors.</strong> Pull in the data that matters to your business and turn it into live, filterable dashboards.</li>
</ul>
<p>Open <a href="https://grok.com/?referrer=website&amp;mode=build">Grok</a> on the web, iOS, or Android, and describe what you want.</p>
